methodology: Fixed-seed fixtures, randomized variant order, fresh process per trial. One archive at a time; bounded hash helper thread permitted. Baseline/current verification, SHA-256 and fsync remain enabled. Every page receives decoded pixel and completeness validation outside conversion timing. Fork defaults can resize/recompress/omit formats; fidelity columns distinguish these cases. Shared host, warm filesystem caches, no pikepdf installed.
